Here’s a classic recipe‑style list of ingredients you’ll typically find in a traditional lasagna:

**For the meat sauce (Bolognese):**
- Olive oil – 2 Tbsp
- Onion, finely chopped – 1 medium
- Carrot, diced – 1 small
- Celery stalk, diced – 1 small
- Garlic cloves, minced – 2–3
- Ground beef or a mix of ground beef & pork – 500 g (about 1 lb)
- Tomato paste – 2 Tbsp
- Crushed tomatoes or passata – 400 ml (about 14 oz can)
- Red wine (optional) – 120 ml (½ cup)
- Milk or cream – 120 ml (½ cup) – helps mellow acidity
- Salt & pepper – to taste
- Dried oregano or Italian seasoning – 1 tsp
- Fresh basil leaves – handful (added at the end)

**For the béchamel (white sauce):**
- Butter – 50 g (¼ cup)
- All‑purpose flour – 50 g (¼ cup)
- Whole milk – 600 ml (about 2 cups)
- Nutmeg – pinch (freshly grated if possible)
- Salt & white pepper – to taste

**Other components:**
- Lasagna sheets – 250 g (about 9 x13 inch tray size; use no‑boil or pre‑cooked sheets if you’re short on time)
- Shredded mozzarella cheese – 200 g (7 oz)
- Grated Parmesan cheese – 100 g (3 ½ oz)
- Optional extras: ricotta or cottage cheese mixed with an egg for added richness, spinach or sautéed mushrooms for extra veggies, or a splash of lemon juice to brighten the sauce.

**Optional garnish:**
- Fresh parsley or basil, chopped – for serving
- Extra grated Parmesan – for topping before baking

That’s it! Mix up the sauces, layer them with pasta sheets, top with cheeses, bake until bubbly and golden, then let rest a few minutes before slicing. Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
